# Checklist — Maintainability

| id | Check | Default severity | Source |
|----|-------|-------------------|--------|
| MAINT-01 | A README documents setup, run and test instructions | Warning | fallback rubric |
| MAINT-02 | Module/folder boundaries are clear and consistent with the intended architecture | Information | fallback rubric |
| MAINT-03 | Environment variables and prerequisites are documented (e.g. `.env.example`) | Warning | fallback rubric |
| MAINT-04 | TODO/FIXME/HACK markers are tracked, not accumulating indefinitely without follow-up | Information | fallback rubric |
| MAINT-05 | Deprecated code paths are removed or clearly marked, not left silently in place | Information | fallback rubric |
